Experience the vintage action ROTI full movie (1974) in 4K starring Rajesh Khanna and Mumtaz on your TV screen. Watch now for a classic cinematic experience!
When Mangal, a seasoned criminal, is sentenced to death, he escapes from prison with the help of a gang lord. While he attempts to start a new life, the police look for him.
Roti (transl. Flatbread) is a 1974 Indian Hindi-language action drama film directed by Manmohan Desai.
The film stars Rajesh Khanna and Mumtaz in lead roles along with Nirupa Roy, Jagdeep, Viju Khote and Om Prakash in supporting roles.
